name: This Girl Can
line: A campaign about what girls are allowed to do.
deck: We have the name and we have the subject. What it asked for, and when, we cannot yet tell you — while two of our own programmes have been working the same ground for years.

holes.what: This is a name and a subject. No start date, no demand, no action we can name.
holes.unlocks: Three sentences: when it started, what it asked for, and one thing it did.

holes.what: She Leads Change and ME to WE both work with girls in Jagdamba and both have figures. This campaign has neither, and we cannot tell you whether it is the public face of that work or something separate.
holes.unlocks: One line: is this a campaign in its own right, or the name the programmes campaign under?
